production_baseline: 15-error-state ESKF without airspeed or wind states
anti_overfit_rules: Use identical truth, sensor-error draws, initialization, and outage windows for every paired arm.
Freeze train and tune thresholds before opening a separate holdout.
Do not treat IAS or CAS as TAS without a declared conversion.
Do not treat airspeed as ground speed or assume zero wind implicitly.
Do not enable the no-sideslip observation outside a declared qualified flight regime.
Retain negative controls, failed trials, and right-censored recovery results.
promotion_blockers: Implement hardware-neutral barometer and TAS source contracts.
Implement paired synthetic generator and scorer.
Freeze quantitative train/tune gates before candidate scoring.
Demonstrate causal wind observability before adding airspeed-bias states.
Run a newly sealed holdout exactly once after source and gates are frozen.
